major_cooldowns.name: Doom Winds
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Press it every minute lined up with Surging Totem, then spend the window weaving Stormstrike and Crash Lightning between Lava Lash casts so Thorim's Invocation discharges a spender on every one of them.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 384352 is the 1 min talent cast; 469270 is the per-second pulse damage and 466772 is the buff aura. Thorim's Invocation extends the window to 10 sec.

major_cooldowns.name: Ascendance
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Take it as the 2 minute replacement for Doom Winds, enter it with Crash Lightning already active and 1-2 Stormstrike charges banked, then fill every GCD with Windstrike to keep discharging Thorim's Invocation.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Table base cooldown is 180s; the guide's 2 minute value is Thorim's Invocation reducing it by 60s. Not pressed in the sampled parse, which ran the Doom Winds build.

major_cooldowns.name: Sundering
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Cast it every 30 sec for the 15% Haste and 5 Maelstrom Weapon stacks from Surging Elements, syncing every other cast with Surging Totem so the Whirling Earth mote doubles its damage.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 197214 is the 30 sec talent cast; 467283 is the per-target damage event.

major_cooldowns.name: Primordial Storm
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Fire the Sundering follow-up at 10 Maelstrom Weapon stacks, dropping to 5+ only when the 15 sec window is about to expire.
major_cooldowns.id_note: No cooldown of its own: it unlocks for 15 sec after each Sundering, so the 30 sec value tracks Sundering's cooldown. 1218125 is the window aura, 1218047 the talent node.

major_cooldowns.name: Surging Totem
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Drop it as close to every minute as possible with your other burst, then sequence Sundering and Lava Lash off it to open the Hot Hand window; re-cast or Totemic Projection moves it off the GCD.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Table base cooldown is 25s; the guide calls it the extra 1 minute cooldown and says to cast it every minute. 1221348 is the re-summon event.

major_cooldowns.name: Algeth'ar Puzzle
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Pre-cast it before the pull, then use it within two GCDs of Ascendance or Doom Winds coming off cooldown so the Mastery lands inside the burst window.
major_cooldowns.id_note: On-use trinket, not an ability; talent_gated is set so players without it are not flagged.

defensives.name: Astral Shift
defensives.usage_rule: Press it for 40% less damage on any telegraphed hit or damage phase you have to stand through.

defensives.name: Earth Elemental
defensives.usage_rule: Use it as a survival tool for the 15% maximum health from Primordial Bond, or as an emergency threat drop without it, never as a damage cooldown.
defensives.id_note: 198103 is the 3 min talent cast; 188616 is the baseline duplicate.

rules.description: Open Voltaic Blaze, Sundering, Lava Lash, Doom Winds
rules.action: Cast Voltaic Blaze on the way into melee, drop Surging Totem, then Sundering for Surging Elements, Lava Lash to start Hot Hand, and Doom Winds into Primordial Storm at 10 Maelstrom Weapon stacks.

rules.description: Sundering always followed by Primordial Storm
rules.action: Every Sundering opens a 15 sec Primordial Storm window: fire it at 10 Maelstrom Weapon stacks, or at 5+ when the window has under 3.5 sec left.

rules.description: Prime Lightning Bolt before Doom Winds
rules.action: Prime Thorim's Invocation with a Lightning Bolt before each Doom Winds in single target, and with Chain Lightning instead from 2 targets up.
Refresh the 12 sec Crash Lightning weapon buff just before pressing Ascendance, then fill every GCD with Windstrike and weave Crash Lightning between casts.

rules.description: Keep the Crash Lightning weapon buff up
rules.action: Cast Crash Lightning on cooldown to hold its 12 sec weapon enhancement: Stormstrike and Lava Lash only splash and generate the extra Maelstrom Weapon while it is active.

rules.description: Chain Lightning from the second target onward
rules.action: Switch your Maelstrom Weapon spender from Lightning Bolt to Chain Lightning the moment a second target is up, and spend at 9+ stacks.
Hold a Sundering charge for each Surging Totem so the Whirling Earth mote doubles its damage and spawns the Searing Totem before it expires.

source_summary: Enhancement runs a one minute burst loop: Surging Totem with Sundering and Lava Lash to open a Hot Hand window, then Doom Winds (or Ascendance every 2 minutes, which replaces it) so Thorim's Invocation discharges a Maelstrom Weapon spender on every Stormstrike, Windstrike and Crash Lightning. Sundering is pressed every 30 sec for the Surging Elements Haste and the Primordial Storm follow-up, which is spent at 10 Maelstrom Weapon stacks. Crash Lightning is a maintenance buff held up at all times, spenders are never hard cast below 5 stacks, and trinkets, potion and racials are stacked into whichever burst window is active.
